commentary: With broad market breadth deteriorated to a weak score of 26 and benchmark indices breaking lower boundaries under relentless FII selling (>₹10,000 crore), market direction sits in an O'Neil correction gate. Stan Weinstein's classic rule applies: during hostile market phases, breakout failure rates soar regardless of chart perfection. Jesse Livermore and Mark Minervini demand disciplined capital preservation through progressive exposure—keep cash dominant, avoid pre-empting pivot turns, and never chase extensions. Only high-relative-strength setups demonstrating undeniable earnings acceleration warrant selective tracking until market health confirms a follow-through day.

analysis.analyst: SEPA / CANSLIM / Stage Analysis (Minervini, O'Neil, Weinstein)

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidating near its 20-session pivot at 104.09 with twin swing lows above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. While volume expanded to 2x average on neckline testing, the stock struggles with heavy overhead supply and lacks relative strength against the market.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational contraction with Q1 FY27 revenues tumbling 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.6% to ₹1.02 Cr. Low return on equity of 3.1% and ROCE of 5.6% reflect absence of operating leverage, disqualifying it under CANSLIM fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breach of swing low support at 97.24 breaks base integrity; exit immediately per Minervini risk discipline.

ADFFOODS.technical: Executing a clean SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance at 331.08 on 2.74x 20-day volume. Price structure holds firmly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 56 reflects constructive, unextended momentum with healthy institutional sponsorship.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Solid top-line expansion with Q1 FY27 sales growing 25.9% YoY to ₹167.3 Cr, though net profit growth of 13.5% trails the 25% CANSLIM standard. Healthy ROCE of 21.8% and prudent leverage provide durable operational strength.
ADFFOODS.risk: A drop below the breakout pivot and stop trigger at 309.63 indicates failure; cut losses quickly.

AEGISLOG.technical: Exemplary Stage 2 market leader progressing in a textbook 3-up power trend above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. The latest up-thrust carried above-average volume, and RSI 58 reflects strong, sustainable institutional accumulation without overbought extension.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM fundamental profile with Q1 FY27 EPS rocketing +269% YoY and revenues advancing 38.2% to ₹2,463 Cr. Surge in high-margin gas distribution and liquid logistics expanded operating leverage, driving ROCE to a powerful 27.6%.
AEGISLOG.risk: A break below 21-EMA dynamic support and scanner stop at 1383.26 signals trend exhaustion; cut immediately.

ALICON.technical: High-conviction 20-day breakout clearing 870.67 backed by institutional demand on 10.48x average volume. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are aligned upward in Stage 2 with MACD confirming upside momentum above the signal and zero line.
ALICON.fundamental: Revenue rose 37.9% YoY to ₹578 Cr in Q1 FY27 backed by an ₹8,450 Cr order backlog. EPS rebounded +22.5% YoY, though input costs compressed EBITDA margins to 9.5%, leaving earnings growth marginally beneath CANSLIM's 25% threshold.
ALICON.risk: Breakdown below the consolidation pivot and stop at 790.64 negates the breakout; liquidate swiftly.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Double bottom base building against the neckline pivot at 953.70, anchored safely above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 64 exhibits notable relative strength, demonstrating aggressive accumulation while broader indices decline.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Explosive operational turnaround in Q1 FY27 as revenue doubled (+111.2% YoY to ₹87.8 Cr) and EPS surged +151.7% to ₹18.15, led by high-margin security technologies. Negligible debt and strong ROCE (29.6%) confirm robust balance sheet strength.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A close below the secondary swing low and stop at 849.35 invalidates the pattern; trigger stop.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Constructive double bottom pattern attempting a neckline advance at 1959.96 on 3.2x average volume. Price holds decisively above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, demonstrating standout relative strength in the transmission sector amid weak market breadth.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Top-line execution remains brisk with Q1 FY27 revenues expanding 47.6% YoY to ₹466.3 Cr on robust transformer orders. However, substantial equity dilution severely contracted quarterly EPS (-65% YoY), conflicting with O'Neil's bottom-line acceleration rule.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Breaching the double bottom base support and stop level at 1804.62 aborts setup; exit without delay.
